2608.10743.title: Mitigating Context Interference for Reliable and Efficient Search Agents
2608.10743.paper_summary: Recent research empowers Large Language Models (LLMs) as multi-turn search agents to iteratively retrieve and generate outputs until complex tasks are solved. However, the contexts of multi-turn search agents are lengthy and complex. For example, the retrieved set of documents in each turn would inevitably introduce irrelevant information that distracts LLMs, referring to \textit{context interference}, potentially hindering the reliability and efficiency of search agents. Therefore, we conduct a systematic study on context interference in multi-turn search agents, focusing on investigating i) which parts of the context of search agents will contribute to the context interference, ii) how to refine the contexts of search agents to mitigate the interference, and iii) can incorporating context refinement into search agent training yield further improvements. We reveal that interference primarily arises from the latest retrieved documents. Based on the explored findings, we then introduce a distill-based context refiner to dynamically mitigate context interference for multi-turn search agents. Finally, we validate that incorporating context refinement into RL training pipelines of search agents can significantly enhance both reliability and efficiency. This study highlights the importance of mitigating context interference of search agents, inspiring a novel paradigm of ``refine context and then generate'' for AI agents.
2608.10743.paper_summary_zh: 最近的研究使大型語言模型（LLMs）作為多回合搜索代理能夠迭代地檢索和生成輸出，直到解決複雜任務。然而，多回合搜索代理的上下文長且複雜。舉例來說，每一回合檢索到的文檔集不可避免地會引入與主題無關的信息，這會分散LLMs的注意力，這被稱為\textit{上下文干擾}，可能會妨礙搜索代理的可靠性和效率。因此，我們對多回合搜索代理中的上下文干擾進行了系統研究，重點調查i) 搜索代理的上下文中哪些部分會導致上下文干擾，ii) 如何精煉搜索代理的上下文以減輕干擾，以及iii) 將上下文精煉納入搜索代理訓練是否能帶來進一步的改善。我們揭示干擾主要來自最新檢索到的文檔。根據探索的結果，我們隨後引入了一種基於蒸餾的上下文精煉器，以動態減輕多回合搜索代理的上下文干擾。最後，我們驗證了將上下文精煉納入搜索代理的強化學習訓練流程可以顯著提高可靠性和效率。本研究強調了減輕搜索代理上下文干擾的重要性，啟發了一種新的“先精煉上下文再生成”的AI代理範式。
